basic_details.job_title: NHM Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Non Medical Supervisor NLEP under NHM, Psychologist Posts
basic_details.short_information: The National Health Mission, Chandigarh has invited applications for two contractual posts: one Psychologist (Clinical Psychologist) (DEIC-RBSK) and one Non Medical Supervisor (NMS) under NLEP. Bio-data on the Application Format, with attested documents and a photograph, is to be submitted to the O/o Mission Director, NHM, 4th Floor, Administrative Block, Govt. Multi Speciality Hospital, Sector-16, Chandigarh. Applications must be received by 16 November 2026 up to 1.00 pm.

age_limit.details: The age limit for the above mentioned category is up to 60 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

post_wise_qualification.post_name: Non Medical Supervisor (NMS) NLEP under NHM

qualification.details: The notice shows no vacancy under the SC and OBC columns for either post. | A Post-Graduate degree in Psychology or Clinical Psychology or Applied Psychology (full time course). Master of Philosophy in Clinical Psychology or Medical & Social Psychology obtained after completion of a full time course of two years which includes supervised clinical training, from any University recognized by the University Grants Commission established under the University Grants Commission Act, 1956 and approved and recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India Act, 1992. | BSc (full time course) with 5 years experience in the field of health, OR training as Non-Medical Supervisor with 5 years experience of working in Govt. or NGO organization in the field of Leprosy. WITH working knowledge of computers. | The age limit for the above mentioned category is up to 60 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

selection_process: The criteria of selection printed in the notice is a written test of 100 marks. The list of eligible candidates and details regarding the written test will be displayed on the official website www.nrhmchd.gov.in on 30 November 2026. The notice does not print the syllabus
the duration or the test date.
The Mission Director reserves the right to cancel the written test without assigning any reason. No TA/DA will be paid for the written test.
important_instructions: Both posts are on contract basis initially up to 31 March 2027, extendable depending on performance and conduct etc. or the duration of the project. The Mission Director, NHM reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies. Only candidates with the requisite qualifications mentioned in the notice are to apply. Incomplete applications and applications received after the due date will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About NHM Chandigarh
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Mission Director, National Health Mission, Chandigarh, from the 4th Floor, Administrative Block, GMSH-16, Chandigarh. The posts are under NHM: the Psychologist post is attached to DEIC-RBSK and the Non Medical Supervisor post to NLEP.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Address: O/o Mission Director, National Health Mission, 4th Floor, Administrative Block, Govt. Multi Speciality Hospital, Sector-16, Chandigarh. The notice does not print a PIN code, an envelope superscription or a postal mode. Prepare the Bio-data on the Application Format, which is available on the website www.nrhmchd.gov.in . Attach self-attested photocopies of certificates and testimonials from matriculation onwards. Attach one recent attested passport size photograph. Submit the application to the O/o Mission Director at the address above so that it is received by 16 November 2026, 1.00 pm. Incomplete applications and applications received after the due date will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice shows no vacancy under the SC and OBC columns for either post. A Post-Graduate degree in Psychology or Clinical Psychology or Applied Psychology (full time course). Master of Philosophy in Clinical Psychology or Medical & Social Psychology obtained after completion of a full time course of two years which includes supervised clinical training, from any University recognized by the University Grants Commission established under the University Grants Commission Act, 1956 and approved and recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India Act, 1992. BSc (full time course) with 5 years experience in the field of health, OR training as Non-Medical Supervisor with 5 years experience of working in Govt. or NGO organization in the field of Leprosy. WITH working knowledge of computers. The age limit for the above mentioned category is up to 60 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

No TA/DA will be paid for the written test.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NHM Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Psychologist (Clinical Psychologist) (DEIC-RBSK) and one Non Medical Supervisor (NMS) NLEP, both in the General column. The Mission Director may increase or decrease the number of vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 16 November 2026 up to 1.00 pm. Applications received after the due date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Psychologist post?
faq.answer: A full time Post-Graduate degree in Psychology, Clinical Psychology or Applied Psychology, and a Master of Philosophy in Clinical Psychology or Medical & Social Psychology after a full time two-year course with supervised clinical training, as described in the notice.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Non Medical Supervisor post?
faq.answer: BSc (full time course) with 5 years experience in the field of health, OR training as Non-Medical Supervisor with 5 years experience in Govt. or NGO organization in the field of Leprosy, along with working knowledge of computers.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit for the posts is up to 60 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated amount is Rs. 30,000 per month for the Psychologist and Rs. 32,169 per month for the Non Medical Supervisor.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NHM Chandigarh posts?
faq.answer: Submit Bio-data on the Application Format available on the website, with self-attested photocopies of certificates from matriculation onwards and one recent attested passport size photograph, to the O/o Mission Director, NHM, 4th Floor, Administrative Block, Govt. Multi Speciality Hospital, Sector-16, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The selection criterion printed is a written test of 100 marks. The list of eligible candidates and written test details will be displayed on www.nrhmchd.gov.in on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on contract basis initially up to 31 March 2027, extendable depending on performance and conduct etc. or the duration of the project.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the written test?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for the written test.
